issue.title: Stop recurring agent_publication error notifications
issue.description: Approving a plan and running research agents no longer produce `agent_publication` error notifications. Any refusal that remains states its real reason and retires instead of repeating. Rows already stuck by these bugs clear through verified acknowledgment, not by being dropped.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/agent_publication_notifications.md requests this work

issue.title: Planner prompt-archive rows use linked (page-only) scope
issue.description: planner-scope: planner approvals enqueue their prompt-archive row with linked scope, and enqueue merges keep revision scope when either side has it, so the revision gate stops refusing rows for commits the planner never made.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/agent_publication_notifications.md defines phase planner-scope as one work unit

issue.title: Report the real refusal reason and retire repeated refusals
issue.description: honest-errors: gate refusals record the Rust completion decision's reason instead of "did not materialize", the dead retire-on-repeat path works again, and the stale-revision doctor hint stops recommending a repair that cannot apply.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/agent_publication_notifications.md defines phase honest-errors as one work unit

issue.title: Stop re-scanning already-published bytes on every hood publish
issue.description: hood-scan-reuse: targeted hood publication skips the protection scan for bytes identical to the previously published file reference, which brings the research hood back under the 120s drain budget.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/agent_publication_notifications.md defines phase hood-scan-reuse as one work unit

issue.title: Deferred restore rebuilds the plan-named planner archive (sase-1c0)
issue.description: planner-restore: persist the planner archive inputs in the planner's artifacts directory so a deferred restore rebuilds the same plan-named archive with its PLAN link, then close sase-1c0.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/agent_publication_notifications.md defines phase planner-restore as one work unit

issue.title: Parse bracketed footer values that lack a link definition
issue.description: footer-brackets: the sase-core commit-footer parser unwraps `SASE_BEAD=[id]` values that have no reference definition, and sase rebuilds the cached stitch-rule rows, so the `bead:[...]` warning stops appearing in digests.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/agent_publication_notifications.md defines phase footer-brackets as one work unit

issue.title: Report-first re-scope repair for proven planner rows
issue.description: planner-repair: add a report-first `sase agent sync --repair-planner-scopes` mode that re-scopes only evidence-proven planner rows to linked through the outbox mutation API, with an audit record.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/agent_publication_notifications.md defines phase planner-repair as one work unit

issue.title: Clear the already-stuck planner and research rows
issue.description: stuck-row-cleanup: once the fixes are live, re-scope proven planner rows and retry each targeted row by key, then verify that every one cleared through acknowledgment with its pages and archives intact.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/agent_publication_notifications.md defines phase stuck-row-cleanup as one work unit
